metadata.formula: For each month and channel, monthly remittances / same channel's full-year remittances * 100, then unweighted mean of four complete fiscal years.
metadata.limit: Each channel has its own annual denominator. Direct studies is the reporting line, not a complete education total.

pov26.child_poverty_2023.title: Household consumption poverty below $8.30: ages 0-5 versus all ages, selected states, HCES 2023-24

metadata.basis: SPID Data, IND year2023, ref_year2023.58, survnameHCES; direct survey estimates; not GSAP calendar lineup.
metadata.groups: Nested comparisons: all ages includes children aged0-5. Household per-capita consumption, not children's own spending or within-household allocation.
metadata.coverage: 14 selected states shown; ages0-5 share is higher than ALL in all36 states/UTs. No national child headcount is inferred without weights.

pov26.decile_real_growth_2022_2023.title: Real consumption growth by survey decile, HCES 2022-23 to 2023-24

metadata.formula: decile mean = national mean * decile share / 0.1; growth = (mean2023 / mean2022 - 1) * 100
metadata.basis: Repeated survey cross-sections, not the same people; daily 2021 PPP consumption means.

pov26.peer_thresholds_2024.title: Poverty headcounts at common 2021 PPP lines, selected Asian countries, 2024

metadata.selection: Five selected Asian comparators, not an exhaustive ranking or a single income group; Indonesia is upper-middle-income.
metadata.basis: Common calendar year and PPP vintage, but estimate_type is actual for Indonesia and projection for the other four. Projection includes lineup estimates, not a new household survey.

pov26.poverty_buffer_2024.title: Poverty headcounts under a hypothetical uniform 10% real consumption loss, 2024 bins

metadata.scenario: Hypothetical uniform 10% real consumption loss, not a forecast or transition probability.
metadata.formula: sum(pop where welf*(1-loss)<line) / sum(pop) * 100; loss is 0 or 0.10
metadata.resolution: Approximately 0.1 percentage point; baseline and scenario both use the same 1,000 population bins.
metadata.differenceFromHeadline: Bin headcounts approximate the full-precision Country_FGT lineup estimates.
